verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a full OpenAPI spec, CLI, SDKs, and API examples for creating collections, source connections, syncing, and searching (docs-25, docs-1/2, docs-6/26, probe-2), suggesting broad API/UI parity, but no explicit documentation confirms every UI action (e.g., dashboard-only settings, webhooks config, org management) is fully mirrored in the API. missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing 100% UI-feature coverage via API, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this parity.
